Closes #38 and #39

- use `unrolled_map_into_tuple(identity, nt)` to recreate functionality of `Tuple(nt)`
- add tests for wide names tuples


Added:

run ci on 1.13 instead of 1.11

Fix `unrolled_unique` and `unrolled_allunique` for Julia 1.12+
title: Wide NamedTuple fix

body:
This PR removes calls to `unrolled_*_into_tuple` and call `_unrolled_map` directly. This removes extra compilation work from calling `unrolled_*_into_tuple`.


This branch and the `kp/latency` branch on ClimaCore (see https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/pull/2723) gave a -9.2% decrease in latency. See https://buildkite.com/clima/climacoupler-time-to-first-step/builds/63#01a1cd39-0885-49c2-ba1e-6be28b8239ba.
title: Remove forwarding layers in some unrolled funcs
